source.notes: Korean-localized recomposition of a human-produced elevator-CCTV anecdote. Preserve the private-goofy-ritual to security-echo to CCTV-realization structure; do not invent punishment, viral exposure, named-company facts, or broader humiliation.

episode_only.role: building security employee who casually echoes Harin's private elevator phrase
episode_only.identity_digest: Korean man in his late forties to fifties; compact neat short dark hair with slight gray allowed; ordinary rectangular or softly rounded face; calm dry expression; simple navy or charcoal building-security uniform with no readable company logo, badge text, or decorative insignia; visually plain and non-threatening, not comedic caricature, not Taemin-like, no glasses unless required later.

slides.beat: Later, the security employee casually repeats Harin's supposedly private phrase.
